valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2026, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 75.05 percent a year from FY2021 (1.5176e+07) to FY2026 (2.49452e+08), over 5 years
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2026
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 2.367e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NGX.json)
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the column the multiple stands on, labelled FY2026, is the period ended 30 June 2026. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
